record.name: Wookiee
record.description: Towering and fiercely loyal, Wookiees are famed for their strength, climbing prowess, and unyielding bonds of honor.

innate_traits.name: Feral Strength
innate_traits.narrative: A Wookiee's rage is a powerful weapon. When pushed, you can enter a state of primal fury, striking with overwhelming force.

mechanics.name: Feral Strike
mechanics.description: Once per short rest, when you hit with a melee or unarmed attack, you can activate this ability to deal an additional 2d4 damage.

innate_traits.name: Climbing Claws
innate_traits.narrative: Your hands and feet house retractable claws, a biological inheritance from a life spent in the canopy of Kashyyyk's wroshyr trees.

innate_traits.name: Indomitable Roar
innate_traits.narrative: Your powerful roar is not just a challenge; it's a manifestation of an unbreakable will that steels you against fear.

mechanics.description: You have advantage on all saving throws against being frightened.

appearance_profile.llm_description_prompt: Describe a Wookiee character. Emphasize their towering presence, the texture and color of their fur, and their powerful, dignified bearing. Their eyes should convey both intelligence and primal strength. Consider their traditional Kashyyyk heritage and the stories their scars and adornments might tell.

class_synergies.narrative: A Wookiee's legendary loyalty and protective instincts make them a natural Guardian, willing to endure any hardship to defend their friends and honor their life-debts.
mechanical_benefits: Feral Strength trait synergizes with Guardian's defensive abilities
High Constitution supports Guardian's tank role
Indomitable Roar enhances Guardian's ability to protect allies

class_synergies.narrative: Combining their immense strength with formal combat training, a Wookiee Soldier is one of the most terrifying melee combatants in the galaxy.
mechanical_benefits: Climbing Claws provide natural weapons for unarmed combat
Feral Strength amplifies Soldier's damage output
Natural durability supports frontline combat role

class_synergies.narrative: Wookiees' arboreal heritage and natural climbing abilities make them exceptional Scouts, able to navigate any terrain and track prey with primal instincts.
mechanical_benefits: Climbing Claws enable vertical exploration and ambush tactics
Keen senses from arboreal hunting background
Natural stealth in forest and urban environments

class_synergies.narrative: When a Wookiee's rage is unleashed, few can stand against their primal fury and overwhelming strength.
mechanical_benefits: Feral Strength trait perfectly complements Berserker's rage mechanics
Indomitable Roar enhances Berserker's intimidation abilities
Natural durability supports reckless combat style

faction_synergies.narrative: Wookiees' strong sense of justice and resistance to oppression made them natural allies of the Rebellion, with many serving as elite warriors and loyal companions.
Wookiees fiercely defend their homeworld and traditions, forming tight-knit communities that resist external threats and exploitation.
Some Wookiees find kinship with Mandalorian culture, respecting their warrior traditions and code of honor while bringing their own unique strength to the clan.

species_progression.base_description: Your species is naturally strong and resilient. You have advantage on Strength checks and gain resistance to bludgeoning damage.

level_5.description: Your legendary strength has grown more formidable. Your natural weapons and unarmed strikes deal additional damage.

level_10.description: Your strength has become legendary. You can use your Strength modifier for Intimidation checks, and your presence alone can cow lesser beings.

level_15.description: Your strength has reached epic proportions. Once per long rest, you can perform a feat of legendary strength.

mechanical_effect.description: As an action, you can attempt a feat of legendary strength (break through walls, lift massive objects, etc.)

level_20.description: Your strength has become truly legendary. You are a living embodiment of Wookiee might and resilience.

mechanical_effect.description: Once per long rest, you can add 1d12 to any Strength check or saving throw, and gain advantage on all Strength-based actions for 1 minute

narrative_progression.level_5: Your Wookiee's strength has grown more formidable. Their muscles ripple with barely contained power, and their presence commands respect even from seasoned warriors.
narrative_progression.level_10: Your Wookiee's strength has become legendary. Their very presence can cow lesser beings, and their roar can shake the foundations of buildings. They are a living embodiment of Wookiee might.
narrative_progression.level_15: Your Wookiee's strength has reached epic proportions. They can perform feats that seem impossible to other species - breaking through reinforced walls, lifting starship components, and inspiring awe in all who witness their power.
narrative_progression.level_20: Your Wookiee's strength has become truly legendary. They are a living legend, a force of nature whose very presence can change the course of battles. Their strength is not just physical - it's the strength of their spirit, their loyalty, and their unbreakable will.

cultural_features.name: Life-Debt Tradition
cultural_features.description: Your species' sacred tradition of life-debts, where saving another's life creates an unbreakable bond of loyalty and service.
cultural_features.activation: When someone saves your life or you save another's life
cultural_features.narrative_enhancement: You can call upon the sacred bonds of life-debt, creating unbreakable connections with allies and inspiring others with your unwavering loyalty.

cultural_features.name: Honor-Bound Warrior
cultural_features.description: Your deep connection to Wookiee warrior traditions and the code of honor that guides your actions.
cultural_features.activation: When facing challenges to your honor or defending your principles
cultural_features.narrative_enhancement: Your adherence to Wookiee warrior traditions grants you respect and authority among those who value honor and courage.

cultural_features.name: Kashyyyk Heritage
cultural_features.description: Your deep connection to Kashyyyk's natural world and the wisdom of your arboreal ancestors.
cultural_features.activation: When interacting with nature, climbing, or navigating forest environments
cultural_features.narrative_enhancement: You can draw upon the ancient wisdom of Kashyyyk, understanding the natural world in ways that seem almost mystical to other species.

environmental_adaptations.advantage: Natural climbing ability and tree-dwelling expertise
environmental_adaptations.immersion_effect: You move through the trees with natural grace, your arboreal heritage making you perfectly at home in forest canopies and urban vertical spaces.

environmental_adaptations.advantage: Enhanced senses and natural camouflage in forest environments
environmental_adaptations.immersion_effect: Your natural fur and arboreal instincts allow you to blend seamlessly into forest environments, moving silently and tracking prey with primal precision.

environmental_adaptations.advantage: Expertise in navigating urban vertical spaces and climbing structures
environmental_adaptations.immersion_effect: Your climbing abilities translate perfectly to urban environments, allowing you to navigate buildings, rooftops, and vertical spaces as easily as trees.

environmental_adaptations.advantage: Enhanced strength and resilience in high-gravity environments
environmental_adaptations.immersion_effect: Your natural strength and resilience make you perfectly adapted to high-gravity environments, where your power becomes even more formidable.

prompt_schema.base_prompt: A towering, furry Wookiee with {contextual_modifiers} and a fierce expression.

progression_path.emergence:
The nemesis begins as a rumor, whispered among the Wookiee clans. A figure of great strength and ferocity,
said to be on a mission of vengeance against the Wookiees.
progression_path.escalation:
As the Wookiee encounters more clues about their nemesis' identity and motivations, they begin to feel
increasingly threatened and defensive.
progression_path.confrontation:
The Wookiee finally confronts their nemesis in a climactic battle. If victorious, they may emerge with a
newfound sense of respect and admiration for their foe.

resolution_paths.victory: The Wookiee defeats their nemesis, claiming a great triumph for themselves and their clan.
resolution_paths.redemption: The Wookiee finds an opportunity to redeem their nemesis, saving them from a fate worse than death.
resolution_paths.escape: The Wookiee narrowly escapes their nemesis' deadly grasp, but not without scars both physical and emotional.

conflict_triggers: The Wookiee encounters evidence of their nemesis' past wrongdoings
A rival clan member betrays the Wookiee to their nemesis
The Wookiee is ambushed by their nemesis in a treacherous wilderness setting

formation_triggers: The Wookiee discovers their nemesis' identity
A close friend or family member falls victim to their nemesis
personal_vendetta.vendetta_type: A burning desire for revenge and retribution

romance_progression.stage1: The Wookiee notices a romantic interest in another character, but is unsure if the feeling is mutual.
romance_progression.stage2: The Wookiee begins to subtly flirt and show interest in the other character, hoping to initiate a romance.
romance_progression.stage3: The Wookiee and their love interest share a tender moment, solidifying their connection and sparking deeper emotions.
romance_progression.stage4: As the relationship deepens, the Wookiee must confront challenges and obstacles that test their commitment and trust in one another.
romance_progression.stage5: The Wookiee and their partner stand strong together, facing the future with love, loyalty, and mutual support.

romance_events: The Wookiee's romantic interest is kidnapped by a rival clan
A close friend of the Wookiee tries to play matchmaker for them
The Wookiee's partner has a traumatic event in their past that affects their trust and intimacy with the Wookiee

romance_modifiers.loyal: increases relationship tension when faced with external threats

romance_modifiers.precise: allows for more creative and nuanced romantic interactions

overrides.bonding_mechanic: deepening bond through shared experiences and mutual support
overrides.courtship_routine: gift-giving and honor-based rituals to demonstrate commitment

record.flavor_text: Wookiees are known for their deep connection to the natural world, and their reverence for the ancient forest moon of Kashyyyk. Their culture is built upon a profound respect for life, honor, and family - principles that guide them in all aspects of their lives. As a Wookiee, you embody these values, and your actions are shaped by the unwavering commitment to protect and preserve the balance of nature.

llm_guidance.roleplay_guidance: As a Wookiee, you have an innate sense of loyalty and duty. You prioritize family and tribe above all else, and will go to great lengths to defend and support those you care about. However, this strong sense of allegiance can sometimes lead to blind spots and conflicts with others who do not share your values or priorities. Be mindful of this tendency, and strive to find a balance between loyalty and self-awareness.
narrative_hooks: Explore the complexities of Wookiee honor culture
Delve into the ancient history of Kashyyyk and its impact on modern Wookiee society
llm_guidance.social_dynamics: Wookiees are known for their close-knit family bonds, but this also means they can be fiercely protective and sometimes isolationist. Be prepared to navigate these dynamics when interacting with other species or individuals who may not understand or respect Wookiee customs.

ai_behavior.personality:
"Independent, loyal, and fiercely protective. A Wookiee is driven by a strong sense of duty to its loved ones.
 It values honesty and directness in communication."
motivations: Explore the wilderness and discover new things
ai_behavior.combat_behavior:
"A Wookiee is a skilled melee fighter, relying on its strength and agility to take down opponents.
 It will often use its surroundings to gain an advantage in combat."
ai_behavior.social_behavior:
"A Wookiee values building strong relationships through shared experiences and mutual respect.
 It will often go out of its way to help others and support those in need."

relationship_tracking.trust_levels:
"Initial trust levels are high due to the Wookiee's natural loyalty and sense of duty.
 However, this can be broken if the player consistently betrays or disrespects their pack."
relationship_tracking.loyalty_triggers:
"The Wookiee will become more loyal and dedicated to the player if they demonstrate a strong sense of honor
 and protect them from harm. Conversely, failure to uphold these values may erode trust and loyalty."

services: Exploration and navigation (due to their climbing prowess)
Mediation and negotiation (using their natural diplomacy skills)
